text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali held a meeting with visiting Jordanian prime minister on bilateral relations and the Middle East peace process.
- Jordanian Tourism and Antiquities Aqel Beltaji discussed bilateral cooperation in the tourism sector with his Tunisian counterpart Slaheddine Maaoui.
- Airline Tunis Air post-tax net profits were 26.6 million dinars in 1996, up 76.1 percent compared with 1995. Tunis Air will raise its capital to 58.3 million dinars.
- Jordanian Prime Minister Majali says Tunisia and Jordan might set up a joint bank in order to reinforce trade and finance exchanges.
- A Mediterranean exhibition of textile and clothing (TEXMED 97) will be held in Tunis on November 12-15 with 300 participants.
